test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

LB, MC, ?, OG, PK
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a22e849294f30f1c26ce29433dfdc070bc3ce4277a615992ef818dd930b88c5a.png] 

The logic followed here is:

1st Letter:- Increase by +1 in the positional value of alphabets

2nd Letter:- Positional value of Alphabets follows the Prime number series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aaa53bf50b938ef7e02b1f788908fa1a7061992a1baaa9443d99c88c461b2885.png] 

So, '**NE**' will replace the question mark in the given series.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
